identification: About six Power Records (Peter Pan Industries) 'Book and Record Set' 45rpm comics, bagged: three copies of PR17 'The Curse of the Werewolf' (Marvel, 1974), a Superman-type set (PR13 not fully legible) and a Peter Pan 'Book and Record' with Superman S cover. Titles I could read: Curse of the Werewolf only; the others partly hidden. Catalogue says some lack records. Mid-1970s mass-produced US items, not a first-edition book candidate.

entries.price: US$1.49 typical, one US$100 Conan set high grade
entries.venue: GoCollect blog on Power Records (via search summary)
entries.note: Snippet only, not verified. Says many copies are listed at $1.49 and a high-grade Conan set asked $100. Rate about 1 USD = 1.55 AUD; the $1.49 figure converts to about A$2, the $100 to about A$155. Shows common sets are cheap and only top-grade complete scarce titles reach real money.
